scope: extracted four-cardinal anchors before coherent row synthesis

000.observed: Both blue pupils sit high, face tilts up and chin is lifted, clearly different from frontal neutral.
000.reason: Unmistakable upward eye and head cue; lower body remains planted.

090.observed: Head yaws right with nose and eye aim on the screen-right side of face center.
090.reason: Readable right attention at native size, not frontal or mirrored-left.

180.observed: Chin is lowered, bangs tilt forward and blue pupils look below the eyelid midline.
180.reason: Opposes the lifted 000 anchor without altering body baseline.

270.observed: Nose and gaze project to screen-left in an opposing head yaw.
270.reason: Left cardinal reads clearly with natural earring/braid occlusion, feet planted.
